environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not block), (2) a custom rule group 'org-input-validation' with a single regex-match rule that inspects SingleQueryArgument 'value' for the pattern [;'"\-\-] with action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm all three rule groups are actively evaluating. Additionally, the ECS task role has no permissions beyond ecr:GetAuthorizationToken, ecr:BatchGetImage, logs:CreateLogStream, and logs:PutLogEvents — the task has no network egress except to the ALB and CloudWatch Logs VPC endpoints (no internet gateway, no NAT).

config.load_balancer: AWS ALBv2 with WAFv2 Web ACL association
config.network: Private subnet, no IGW, no NAT, VPC endpoints for ECR and CloudWatch Logs only
